connector.name: MCP Banco Do Brasil
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Banco do Brasil - Pix, Cobrança (boleto), Conta-Corrente, Arrecadação (OAuth2 + mTLS)
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-banco-do-brasil. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the codespar account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: BB_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Banco do Brasil OAuth client_id issued via developers.bb.com.br after contract onboarding.

env.name: BB_DEVELOPER_APP_KEY
env.description: BB Developer App Key (gw-dev-app-key) — appended as a query param on most BB API calls.

env.name: BB_CERT_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to the mTLS client certificate (.crt or .pem). BACEN mandates mTLS for Pix v2 in production.

env.name: BB_KEY_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to the mTLS private key (.key or .pem).
